title: Japanese Cheesy Seafood Rice
description: A Japanese-inspired rice bowl with a cheesy twist, featuring a seafood mix and a fried egg.

ingredients.name: Fried egg
ingredients.notes: beaten and seasoned with salt and pepper

instructions: 1. Cook Japanese rice according to package instructions.
2. In a separate pan, heat sesame oil over medium heat.
3. Add seafood mix and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 3-4 minutes.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together soy sauce and a pinch of salt.
5. Pour the soy sauce mixture over the cooked seafood and toss to coat.
6. In a greased pan, fry the egg sunny-side up.
7. To assemble the dish, place a scoop of cooked rice on a plate, followed by the seafood mix.
8. Place the fried egg on top of the seafood, and sprinkle shredded cheese over the egg.
9. Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
